_written: 2026-10-09, before running gen14. Implementation research on the gen13 survivors (F2_EWMAC, F7_COMBO). Signals are NOT changed or re-selected.
period_use: Decisions use DISCOVERY+VALIDATION only. TEST/HOLDOUT were looked at once in gen13 and are reported here as CONTAMINATED-SECONDARY (cost/implementation effect only, never used to choose).

G14a_BUFFER.rule: per instrument, keep the previous weight unless the target leaves [held - b*m, held + b*m], m = trailing-252d mean |target weight|; then trade to the nearer band edge (Carver-style buffering)
G14a_BUFFER.adopt_if: on BOTH DISCOVERY and VALIDATION: net Sharpe at 3x costs improves by >= 0.10 vs unbuffered AND net Sharpe at 1x costs falls by <= 0.05; choose the smallest b that satisfies this (stable-region rule)

G14b_LEVERAGE_CAP.rule: scale the whole book down when gross notional > L

G14c_CAPITAL.rule: integer contracts; for each underlying choose the member with the smallest median contract notional 2015-2024 whose cost/vol <= 0.02; contracts = round(W*C/notional) with a 0.5-contract + 10% no-trade band; FX via pysystemtrade fx_prices_csv
G14c_CAPITAL.metric: net Sharpe and tracking correlation vs the continuous-weight book, VALIDATION and 2014-2024 (contaminated-secondary)
G14c_CAPITAL.use: determines minimum capital for an implementable version; not a signal gate
